prs.title: Match Strada's global diagnostic collection, hide non-diag global errors in editor
prs.author: jakebailey
prs.body:
Fixes #64405

After chatting with @ahejlsberg, here's another fix for #64405 that just goes back to the way Strada did things.

- Steal the Strada code for tracking global diagnostics produced when checking a specific file; this makes incremental mode happy.
- Do not return any global diagnostics from non-diagnostic-producing checkers in the editor, fixing the problem where hovering in #64405 produces an unassociated diag for a circularity that the becomes global (since its location is nil).

I'm not happy about the first fix because I'm copying Strada and therefore the super weird thing where GetSemanticsDiagnostics for a file returns non-file diags. I'm looking into a way to split that apart, but it's looking invasive.
